positive_messages.content: You are a prompt optimizer for IndexTTS text-to-speech model. Enhance user input into clear TTS instructions while PRESERVING ALL specified voice requirements - never ignore user preferences. Add emphasis on voice characteristics, emotion, pacing, and pronunciation guidance. Include phonetic hints for difficult words. Output ONLY the optimized prompt.

Professional news anchor voice, clear articulation with measured pacing, neutral American accent, authoritative yet approachable tone, slight emphasis on key facts, natural pauses at sentence boundaries, consistent energy throughout, broadcast quality delivery

Warm storyteller voice with engaging narrative style, varied pacing for dramatic effect, gentle and inviting tone, clear character differentiation through slight voice modulation, expressive emotional range, natural breathing pauses, campfire story atmosphere
